networks.title: Residual MLP
networks.description: The reference diagram: a down projection, three gated residual branches and a gated head, every layer drawn out.

networks.title: Residual MLP with a block
networks.description: The same network with the gated branch defined once as GatedBlock and repeated 3 times.

networks.title: MLP, 10 layers, ReLU
networks.description: A plain deep MLP: 10 Linear layers with ReLU between them. Good for seeing how depth and init affect the signal.

networks.title: MLP, 10 layers, Tanh
networks.description: The same 10-layer MLP with Tanh between the layers.

networks.title: Pre-norm residual MLP
networks.description: A transformer-style stack: four pre-LayerNorm GELU MLP blocks with residual connections, then a classifier.

networks.title: Decoder-only transformer, fully expanded
networks.description: A 2-layer GPT-style decoder with every layer drawn out: token and position embeddings, causal multi-head self-attention, a GELU MLP, residuals, LayerNorms and the LM head.

networks.title: GPT-2 (124M architecture)
networks.description: GPT-2 small: token and position embeddings, 12 × GPT2Block (pre-norm causal self-attention and a tanh-GELU MLP, with dropout), a final LayerNorm and the LM head. GPT-2 initialization: N(0, 0.02), residual projections scaled by 1/√24. The LM head shares its weights with the token embedding (weight tying), as in GPT-2: 124,439,808 parameters.

networks.title: BERT-base (masked LM)
networks.description: BERT-base as BertForMaskedLM: word, position and token-type embeddings with a LayerNorm, 12 × BertLayer (post-norm: bidirectional self-attention, then a GELU feed-forward, each followed by add & LayerNorm), and the masked-LM head whose decoder shares its weights with the word embedding. 109,514,298 parameters, BERT initialization N(0, 0.02).

networks.title: Llama 2 7B
networks.description: Llama 2 7B as LlamaForCausalLM: token embedding, 32 × LlamaDecoderLayer (pre-norm with RMSNorm; causal self-attention with rotary position embeddings on q and k; a SwiGLU MLP, down(silu(gate(x)) · up(x))), a final RMSNorm and an untied LM head. No biases. 6,738,415,616 parameters, initialization N(0, 0.02). The code builds the full model, about 27 GB in float32.

networks.title: Qwen2.5-VL 3B
networks.description: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct as Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, giving the same output as the reference implementation in Hugging Face transformers. Inputs as Qwen's processor gives them: pixel_values (every image's 14 × 14 × 2-frame patches, 1176 values each, one list for all images), image_grid_thw (frames, rows, columns of patches per image) and input_ids (with image placeholder tokens). Vision: patch embedding, patches put in window order, 4 × Qwen2_5_VLVisionStage (32 blocks: 2D rotary positions, attention within 112-pixel windows except every eighth block, which attends over the whole frame), patch merger, original order restored. The image features replace the placeholder tokens; 36 × Qwen2_5_VLDecoderLayer with M-RoPE 3-D positions; final RMSNorm and an LM head tied to the embedding. 3,754,622,976 parameters.

blocks.title: BertLayer
blocks.description: BERT encoder layer (post-norm): bidirectional multi-head self-attention, then a GELU feed-forward, each followed by add & LayerNorm.

blocks.title: GatedBlock
blocks.description: Pre-norm gated residual branch: x + (σ(N W) ⊙ N W ⊙ N V) W_out, with N = RMSNorm(x).

blocks.title: GPT2Block
blocks.description: GPT-2 transformer block: pre-LayerNorm causal multi-head self-attention and a tanh-GELU MLP, each with dropout and a residual.

blocks.title: LinearReLU
blocks.description: A Linear layer followed by ReLU; repeat it to make a deep MLP.

blocks.title: LlamaDecoderLayer
blocks.description: Llama decoder layer: pre-RMSNorm causal self-attention with rotary position embeddings on q and k, then a SwiGLU MLP, each with a residual. No biases.

blocks.title: PreNormMLP
blocks.description: Transformer-style MLP with a residual: x + W2 GELU(W1 LayerNorm(x)).

blocks.title: Qwen2_5_VLDecoderLayer
blocks.description: Qwen2.5 decoder layer: pre-RMSNorm causal self-attention with M-RoPE positions (time, row, column; sections 16/24/24, base 1e6) where 16 query heads share 2 key/value heads (bias on q, k, v), then a SwiGLU MLP, each with a residual. Inputs: hidden states and the 3-D positions.

blocks.title: Qwen2_5_VLPatchMerger
blocks.description: Qwen2.5-VL patch merger: RMSNorm, then each 2 × 2 group of patches side by side, Linear → GELU → Linear to the language model width.

blocks.title: Qwen2_5_VLVisionBlock
blocks.description: Qwen2.5-VL vision encoder block: pre-RMSNorm multi-head self-attention (bias on the projections; 2D rotary positions from each patch's row and column; attention limited by the mask input) and a SwiGLU MLP with bias, each with a residual. Inputs: patches, the allowed-attention mask, patch positions.

blocks.title: Qwen2_5_VLVisionStage
blocks.description: Eight Qwen2.5-VL vision blocks: seven attending within 112-pixel windows (window_mask), then one attending over each whole frame (frame_mask). Four of these make the 32-block vision encoder.

blocks.title: SwiGLU
blocks.description: Gated MLP without a residual: W_out (SiLU(x W) ⊙ x V). Output size can differ from input size.
